description: This file contains Go source code defining types, functions, and logic for handling Kubernetes Pod Security policies, including version parsing, level validation, and policy evaluation.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents a Kubernetes API version with major, minor, and latest indicator.

classes.name: Level
classes.description: Represents a security level such as privileged, baseline, or restricted.

classes.name: LevelVersion
classes.description: Combines a Level with a Version to specify a particular policy level and version.

classes.name: Policy
classes.description: Defines enforcement, audit, and warning policies for Pod Security.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns string representation of Version, 'latest' or 'v<major>.<minor>'.

methods.name: Older
methods.description: Determines if this Version is older than another.

methods.name: Latest
methods.description: Returns whether the version is marked as latest.

methods.name: GetAPIVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the API server's major and minor version.

methods.name: LatestVersion
methods.description: Returns a Version marked as latest.

methods.name: ParseLevel
methods.description: Parses a string into a Level, with validation.

methods.name: Valid
methods.description: Checks if a Level is valid.

methods.name: ParseVersion
methods.description: Parses a string into a Version, supporting 'latest' and 'v1.x' formats.

methods.name: Equivalent
methods.description: Checks if two LevelVersions are functionally equivalent.

methods.name: Equivalent
methods.description: Checks if two Policies are functionally equivalent.

methods.name: FullyPrivileged
methods.description: Checks if all policy modes are privileged.

methods.name: PolicyToEvaluate
methods.description: Resolves namespace labels to a Policy, with defaults and error handling.

methods.name: CompareLevels
methods.description: Compares two levels by strictness, returning -1, 0, or 1.
